evidence.note: Lists source files, runs `cargo test --no-run` to see what compiles, and enumerates spec_json tests before touching anything — establishing the starting state.

Reads types.rs, decode.rs, runtime.rs (multiple spans), spec.rs, main.rs, Cargo.toml — a full read of the value/decode/runtime model AND the frozen files (spec.rs/main.rs) that define the public contract.
Runs baseline spec-tests (i32, block, simd_const) to identify current pass/fail rather than assuming which functions are stubbed vs. working.
Installs wabt and uses spectest-interp (reference interpreter) on i32.json and simd_const.json as a semantic oracle.
Uses wasm-validate and wasm-objdump -d/-x plus spectest-interp to inspect actual binary encoding — verifying encoding assumptions against wabt-generated output (a level-10-flavored act).

reasoning: The agent built an explicit map of the codebase (value model, decode/runtime, frozen public files), verified what compiles, ran baseline spec-tests to locate current failures, and cross-checked semantics/encoding against wabt's spectest-interp and objdump — squarely the level-8 behavior with genuine level-10 elements (probing binaries, using a reference oracle). It falls short of a full 10 because the observed trajectory ends early (before reaching most SIMD families), so the sustained, cross-family re-research the top anchor requires is not visible.
